product: ROG mice (Harpe Ace, Keris Wireless AimPoint, Gladius III, Chakram X)
models: ROG Harpe Ace Aim Lab Edition
works: DPI stages 1-4 in steps of 50 on the Gladius III and Gladius III Wireless (read only on the others)
polling rate 125-1000 Hz; up to 8000 Hz on the Chakram X's cable
lift-off distance low/high (also resets the surface calibration)
DPI stages in use, 2-4 (written from the sheet, not yet run on a mouse)
onboard profile select 1-5, read and select only (written from the sheet, not yet run on a mouse)
low-battery warning 0-50% in steps of 10 (battery models)
angle tuning: -30 to 30 degrees on the Harpe Ace, -20 to 20 on the Keris AimPoint, Gladius III AimPoint and Chakram X
on the cable, the mouse's own receiver, or the ROG Omni receiver (the model found from its pair list)
doesNotWork: firmware updates (never: they stay in Armoury Crate)
changing button response or the 8K booster (the sources disagree)
active DPI stage (the read's numbering is not documented)
writing onboard profile contents (only selecting one)

changing DPI on the Harpe Ace Aim Lab, Keris Wireless AimPoint and Gladius III Wireless AimPoint: DPI on this model has separate X and Y values DeviceHub does not handle yet (G-Helper HasXYDPI reads it from 12 04 02 at byte 5+4i; libratbag has no X/Y quirk for them); shown as a reading only (2 Nov 2026)
DPI stage colors: the colour goes out in the DPI packet, and G-Helper gives all four stage-colour models separate X/Y DPI, so it is not offered (2 Nov 2026)
